Protocol J - Jaw/ Mouth (mouth protocol)

Protocol cds protocol joint arthritis

Evidence: Grade B (traditional_use)

Summary

Oral CDS mouthwash protocol for oral hygiene and joyful living. Mild CDS solution used as a daily mouthwash to support oral health, fresh breath, and overall wellbeing. Gentle concentration suitable for daily use. Not for treatment of clinical conditions.

Indications

  • Jaw/Mouth protocol
  • Oral hygiene

Steps

  1. Prepare joint support dose
  2. Combine CDS with supportive herbs if appropriate
  3. Follow support schedule
  4. Monitor joint symptoms
  5. Track mobility

Dosage

Joint support protocol: 1 ml CDS in 100ml water, 2 times daily

Expected Outcomes

  • Joint pain reduction
  • Inflammation reduction
  • Improved mobility
  • Joint support

Monitoring

  • Monitor joint pain
  • Track mobility
  • Watch for inflammatory response
  • Adjust as needed

Frequency: 2 times daily
